translations.web: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
translations.bsb: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to gain, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.
translations.kjv: It is ➔ not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
translations.asv: I must needs glory, though it is not expedient; but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
